title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 11: You Carry It

scenes.say: Helicopter pad. Roddy is zipped into a bag. The squad stands in silence.
scenes.visual: soldiers standing in silence on a helicopter pad, rotor blades still, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Mack: He gave everything. And we honor that by finishing the fight.
scenes.visual: a sergeant standing at attention, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali wipes his tears. Stays composed.
scenes.visual: a gloved hand wiping a face, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You don't bury your past in a coffin. You carry it.
scenes.visual: a helicopter lifting off into a hazy sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Transport plane. Night. Ali flies home, staring out at the clouds.
scenes.visual: a soldier looking out of a military plane window at clouds at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He holds Roddy's dog tags in his hand.
scenes.visual: dog tags held in a closed hand, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I went to war a hoodlum, and came back haunted.
scenes.visual: clouds below a plane wing at night, moonlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twelve. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a plane's lights in a night sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 11 of 25: You Carry It. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
